OVERVIEW & PHILOSOPHY

WHAT IS BIKE DETAILING?

TWO WHEELS. FULL ATTENTION. PRECISION REJUVENATION FOR EVERY RIDE.

Motorcycles expose their mechanical heart directly to road elements. Our Bike Detailing program treats every exposed inch — from delicate chrome headers and engine cooling fins to painted fuel tanks and chain assemblies — with pH-neutral cleansers, precision steam, metal polish, and protective sealants.

ESTIMATED DURATION: 3 - 5 Hours
ADVANTAGES & BENEFITS

KEY ADVANTAGES OF BIKE DETAILING.

01 / BENEFIT

Mechanical Degreasing

Eliminates baked-on chain oil, road tar, and engine grit from tight crevices.

02 / BENEFIT

Chrome & Metal Polish

Restores brightwork, silencers, and aluminum forks to their original shine.

03 / BENEFIT

Paint Correction

Removes rider jacket scratches and zipper marks from the fuel tank.

04 / BENEFIT

Corrosion Protection

Seals electrical connectors and exposed metal against monsoon humidity and winter salt.

STANDARD PROTOCOL

WHAT'S INCLUDED.

Every step executed with certified detailing procedures, filtered spot-free water, and lint-free equipment.

PRECISION BIKE ZONES

TARGETED MOTORCYCLE ZONES.

01 / PAINT & TANK

Rider jacket scratch removal and swirl-free tank gloss polish.

02 / ENGINE & FINS

Solvent degreasing of cooling fins, crankcase, and tight cylinder blocks.

03 / EXHAUST & PIPES

Blueing stain removal, heat oxidation cleanup, and bright chrome polish.

PRECISION PROCEDURE

OUR APPLICATION PROCESS.

01

Cool-Down & Pre-Rinse

Allowing engine to reach ambient temperature followed by safe low-pressure rinse.

02

Chemical De-greasing

Targeted solvent brush agitation across sprockets, chain, and crankcase.

03

Snow Foam Bath

Lifting surface dust without abrasive contact.

04

Detailing Brushes

Intricate cleaning of handlebar controls, radiator fins, and swingarms.

05

Tank & Panel Polish

Precision rotary polish on painted fairings and tank contours.

06

Dress & Protect

Non-greasy tyre dressing, chain lubrication, and hydrophobic sealant spray.
